Note that the factor $2\operatorname{arctan}⁡(x+3)-3\pi $ is always negative. We know this because

$$
-\frac{\pi }{2}<\operatorname{arctan}⁡(x+3)<\frac{\pi }{2}\,⇒\,-4\pi <2\operatorname{arctan}⁡(x+3)-3\pi <-2\pi .
$$

Since $2\operatorname{arctan}⁡(x+3)-3\pi $ is always negative, we can divide both sides of the inequality by this quantity, but we have to remember to flip the sign of the inequality. By doing this, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}(2\operatorname{arctan}⁡(x+3)-3\pi )(2x+9) & <0 \\ \frac{(2\operatorname{arctan}⁡(x+3)-3\pi )(2x+9)}{2\operatorname{arctan}⁡(x+3)-3\pi } & >\frac{0}{2\operatorname{arctan}⁡(x+3)-3\pi } \\ 2x+9 & >0 \\ 2x & >-9 \\ x & >-\frac{9}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
